naive_failure_mode: FAILFAST crashes job; DROPMALFORMED drops valid $24.99 order O1011.
functional_fix_applied: Read CSV in PERMISSIVE mode with _corrupt_record; extract trailing token into rescued_extra and retain valid 7 columns.

naive_failure_mode: NULL unit_price on truncated order O2009 yields NULL line revenue and silently drops $59.98 of Home & Office sales.
functional_fix_applied: Apply COALESCE(orders.unit_price, products.list_price) during Silver-to-Gold product join while flagging imputed rows.

naive_failure_mode: Ragged 6-field line (O2009) misses unit_price and region, crashing strict parsers or leaking NULL grouping keys.
functional_fix_applied: Capture raw line via _corrupt_record, default missing region to 'Unknown', and backfill unit_price from catalog list_price in Gold join.

naive_failure_mode: Direct CAST('$1,099.00' AS DECIMAL) throws ANSI CAST_INVALID_INPUT or yields NULL; naive comma split shifts columns.
functional_fix_applied: Parse RFC-4180 quotes in CSV reader and strip [$,] via regexp_replace before try_cast('decimal(12,2)').

naive_failure_mode: Default ISO to_date fails on '01/01/2024' & '01/02/2024'; dd/MM/yyyy misclassifies Jan 2 order O2001 into February.
functional_fix_applied: Parse via deterministic coalesce(try_to_date(yyyy-MM-dd), try_to_date(MM/dd/yyyy), epoch_utc).

naive_failure_mode: Epoch string '1704153600' fails date cast, or shifts from 2024-01-02 UTC back to 2024-01-01 in US local timezones.
functional_fix_applied: Pin spark.sql.session.timeZone=UTC and convert 10-digit epochs via to_date(timestamp_seconds(try_cast(bigint))).

naive_failure_mode: 'west' and 'east' split Gold aggregations into duplicate lowercase/uppercase region rows.
functional_fix_applied: Normalize via initcap(lower(trim(region))) in Silver orders.

naive_failure_mode: 'electronics' (P002) and 'kitchen' (P006) split Gold category aggregations while 'Home & Office' contains '&'.
functional_fix_applied: Normalize via initcap(lower(trim(category))) in Silver products (preserving 'Home & Office').

naive_failure_mode: Over-eager NOT NULL filtering on customer_id discards $80.95 of valid guest-checkout sales (O1004, O2005).
functional_fix_applied: Normalize blank strings to NULL and retain guest orders in Silver and Gold.

naive_failure_mode: Zero-unit order O1008 adds $0 revenue but inflates Stationery/North order_count (1 -> 2), cutting AOV in half.
functional_fix_applied: Classify qty=0 as ZERO_QUANTITY in Silver and exclude qty=0 lines from Gold daily_sales aggregation.

naive_failure_mode: Order O1002 ($1,099.00) appears identically in both 01-01 and 01-02 drops; append-only pipelines double-count revenue.
functional_fix_applied: Deduplicate via Window(partitionBy order_id orderBy drop_date DESC) + idempotent Delta MERGE on order_id.

naive_failure_mode: Order O1003 (order_date 2024-01-01) updates qty 5 -> 6 in 01-02 drop; overwriting only drop_date=01-02 leaves 01-01 stale.
functional_fix_applied: MERGE Silver where src.drop_date >= tgt.drop_date and dynamically recompute Gold for all impacted order_dates.

naive_failure_mode: Orders O1007 (P099) and O2007 (P011) reference SKUs absent from products.csv; INNER JOIN silently loses $49.99.
functional_fix_applied: LEFT JOIN silver_products and COALESCE(category, 'Unknown') so total daily revenue reconciles 100%.

naive_failure_mode: Return O2004 (qty=-1, -$1,099) is the sole row in 2024-01-02/Electronics/West -> divide-by-zero or negative AOV.
functional_fix_applied: Include qty<0 in net_revenue and units_sold; count qty>0 orders in order_count; guard AOV when order_count == 0 (NULL).
